text:
The Executive Post Graduate Programme in Applied AI and Agentic AI by upGrad and IIIT Bangalore is a 7-month advanced certification designed for professionals who want to go beyond traditional AI.
This program helps you master both Applied AI and Agentic AI, enabling you to design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents that can plan, act, and make autonomous decisions in real-world settings.
Through 240+ hours of learning, 8+ projects, and 2 industry-grade capstones, you'll learn how to apply Agentic AI concepts to design and build real-world solutions across 12+ industry domains, including Healthcare, BFSI, Retail, Manufacturing, Media, Education, LegalTech, and more.

Projects & Capstones: 30+ Hands-on Projects and 2 Industry Capstones

heading: What is Generative AI?
text:
Generative AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that create new content such as text, code, images, audio, video, and more. These systems learn from large datasets and use that knowledge to produce new outputs. Unlike traditional AI systems that only classify or predict based on rules, generative AI creates new content based on input instructions, also known as prompts.
Some of the most widely used generative AI models today include Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and Llama. These models understand context, generate clear and meaningful text, write working code, summarize content, translate languages, and support creative tasks.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: Real Life Use Cases of Generative AI
text:
Generative AI is not just limited to any single domain, it work across industries and help teams to improve their productivity.
Software Engineering: It supports coding, reviews code, creates documentation, and writes test cases.
Financial Services: It generates reports, analyzes documents, supports fraud-related narratives, and creates compliance summaries.
E-commerce and Retail: It creates personalized product descriptions, supports pricing communication, and powers conversational shopping experiences.
Healthcare: It summarizes clinical notes, improves patient communication, documents drug interactions, and supports medical research.
Marketing and Communication: It creates content, writes campaign copy, adapts content into multiple languages, and supports SEO strategies.
Legal and Consulting: It analyzes contracts, supports research, creates proposals, and manages knowledge systems.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: What Is Agentic AI?
text:
Generative AI models responds to prompts and gives a single output. Agentic AI works with goals. It plans tasks, uses tools, gathers data, takes actions, and improves results based on feedback. You do not need to guide every step.
For example, a generative AI model can summarize a customer complaint, whereas an Agentic AI model can resolve it. It reads the issue, checks order history, reviews policies, decides the next step, sends a response, and updates records. It completes the full process from start to finish.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: Core Capabilities of Agentic AI Systems
text:
Agentic AI systems bring together multiple capabilities that go beyond basic generative AI models:
Goal understanding: It understands a high-level objective and identifies what it needs to do to achieve it.
Planning and decomposition: It breaks a complex goal into smaller, clear, and actionable steps.
Tool use and integration: It connects with tools like databases, search engines, email systems, calendars, and code environments to gather data and take action.
Memory and context retention: It keeps track of information across steps and uses past context to make better decisions.
Self-evaluation and improvement: It reviews its own outputs and improves results when needed.
Multi-agent collaboration: It works with other AI agents to complete tasks that require coordination across different steps or domains.

heading: 6 . What is the difference between Generative AI and Agentic AI?
text:
Generative AI creates content based on prompts. It generates text, images, code, reports, or summaries when users provide specific instructions. These systems focus on producing relevant and context-aware outputs in response to input queries.
Agentic AI goes beyond content creation. It plans, reasons, uses tools, accesses APIs, retains memory of past interactions, and completes multi-step tasks autonomously. Instead of only responding to prompts, it executes actions and manages workflows independently.
In simple terms:
Generative AI responds.
Agentic AI acts.
Agentic AI combines Generative AI capabilities with decision-making, memory, and automation to perform tasks with minimal human intervention.

heading: 10 . What is the role of prompt engineering in Agentic AI?
text:
Prompt engineering plays a foundational role in Agentic AI because it shapes how an AI agent thinks, reasons, and behaves. In agentic systems, prompts define the agent’s role, goals, constraints, and expected output structure. A well-designed prompt directly influences the quality, accuracy, and reliability of the agent’s actions.
Effective prompt engineering enables an AI agent to:
Clearly understand its role and objective
Break down complex tasks into structured steps
Use tools or APIs accurately
Apply logical and step-by-step reasoning
Minimise errors and reduce hallucinations
However, prompt engineering alone does not make a system fully agentic. Agentic AI also incorporates memory systems, planning modules, tool integration, and workflow orchestration to execute multi-step tasks autonomously and efficiently.

heading: Dr. V. Sridhar
text: Dr. V. Sridhar (vsridhar@iiitb.ac.in) is a Professor at the Centre for IT and Public Policy at the International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore, India. He is the author of three books: Telecom Revolution in India: Technology, Regulation and Policy (2012), The Dynamics of Spectrum Management: Legacy, Technology, and Economics (2014), and Emerging ICT Policies and Regulations: Roadmap to Digital Economies (2019). His edited a book titled Data-Centric Living: Algorithms, Digitization and Regulation was published by Routledge (2022). His co-authored new book titled "5G and Beyond: Rewiring Telecom Regulation", has just been published by the Oxford University Press. Dr. Sridhar has taught at many institutions in the USA, Finland, New Zealand and India. He was a Visiting Scholar at the Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism, University of Southern California, U.S.A. during May-June, 2021; April-May, 2022, June 2024 and Mar-July, 2025. He has received funding from different sources, both national and international for his research projects, recent ones being from Facebook. He has been a member of Government of India committees on Telecom and IT and has published many peer-reviewed articles in telecom and information systems journals. He has also written more than 300 article in newspapers and magazines on telecom regulation in India. Dr. Sridhar has a Ph.D. from the University of Iowa, U.S.A. His complete work can be accessed at: http://www.vsridhar.info

metadata.document_title: Forward Deployed AI Engineering Executive PG Certificate IIIT Bangalore

heading: Dr. C. Ramanathan
text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He has been working in the field of Computing for over 25 years in various capacities across industry and academia. He has been associated with IIITB for over 15 years where he has been teaching and carrying out research in diverse areas. His expertise lies in the fields of data science, software engineering, and large scale application development. He holds a Ph.D. degree from Mississippi State University, with his research focused on object-oriented databases. His teaching interests are in the areas of data modeling, data analytics, database design, and software architecture. His current research focus is Data Science, Model-based Software Engineering, and Technology for Education. He has authored several research papers and supervised thesis work of four PhD students, who have now graduated from IIIT-B under his guidance. He is currently heading Machine Intelligence and Robotics Center (MINRO) and Center for Technology Research and Innovation – Digital Governance (CTRI-DG), both of which are funded by Government of Karnataka. He is passionate about the use of technology for improving the quality of education. He serves on the Technical Advisory Panels of many departments of the Government of Karnataka including the Department of Education, Finance, and Center for Smart Governance. He also serves as a subject-matter expert on the Board of Studies of several HEI (Higher Educational Institutions). Dr. Chandrashekar was a Board member in the “Board for IT Education Standards (BITES)” between 2013 and 2023. He was recognized in the list of “Top 10 Data Science academicians of India” by the Analytics India magazine for the year 2018 and again in 2019.

heading: Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering
text:
AI deployment is moving beyond the basic model building. Companies and businesses need engineers who can understand a business problem, design the right solution, build AI systems, integrate them into enterprise environments, and take them into production.
The Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering from IIIT Bangalore is built for engineers who want to own AI results end-to-end, not just build models in isolation.
The program is delivered by IIIT-B, a NIRF Top 100, NAAC A+ rated institution with alumni network working at Amazon, HSBC, ICICI, Kotak, Microsoft, Jio, and Swiggy. Below is a full breakdown of what it teaches, who it's for, what it costs, and how to apply.

heading: What is the Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering?
text:
This is a 120+ hour, 6-month executive programme designed to train engineers for the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) role: the person who sits at the intersection of client discovery, AI architecture, and production deployment.
Rather than treating GenAI as a standalone skill, the Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering teaches learners to scope a client's real problem, build the AI solution, deploy it into the industry environments, and defend the outcome to business stakeholders.
The program includes:
5 hands-on projects across the curriculum
1 live client capstone on Demo Day
A 1-day campus immersion at IIIT Bangalore
Sessions delivered by practicing Forward Deployed Engineers and AI experts, not only academic faculty
IIIT Bangalore alumni status on completion
Anyone searching for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer Course Online will notice most options are either pure GenAI courses or pure cloud-deployment courses. This program combines both GenAI and cloud deployment, making it ideal for professionals who need an Forward Deployed Engineer course online option rather than a full-time, on-campus course.

heading: Who is a Forward Deployed Engineer?
text:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is an engineer who works closely with clients to understand their problems and build solutions that can be used in real-world settings. Instead of stopping after creating a demo, an FDE takes the project from problem identification and solution planning to development and production.
The curriculum of this program reflects this directly, teaching learners to "think like an FDE": client discovery, architecture and solution scoping, not just model training.

heading: IIM Kozhikode Strategic AI for Business Professionals Program
text:
IIM Kozhikode Strategic AI for Business Professionals is a 6-month, blended Professional Certificate Program in AI for Business Professionals, built for leaders who need to make AI decisions, not just understand AI concepts.
88% of companies now use AI in at least one business function, yet most non-technical professionals are stuck choosing between courses that are too technical to follow or too theoretical to apply. This AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program from IIM Kozhikode is designed to eliminate that choice entirely; no coding required.
It includes:
90+ hours of self-paced content, live workshops, and applied projects
6 modules plus a Leadership Capstone, built around your own organization's AI opportunity
A 2-day campus immersion at IIM Kozhikode, with a case competition and capstone presentation
A Certificate of Successful Completion from IIM Kozhikode
This program is also referred to informally as the AI for Business Professionals Course or the IIM Kozhikode AI Course, though the official name on your credential is the Professional Certificate Program in AI for Business Professionals.

metadata.document_title: IIMK AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program

heading: Why Choose this Professional Certificate Program in AI for Business Professionals?
text:
The IIMK AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program teaches how to apply AI in your domain and your organization, not just understand it in the abstract.
Learn AI Without Coding: Learn AI without a technical background, anchored to a real business deliverable in every module.
Apply AI Across Business Functions: AI playbooks across Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, and Sales, not one-size-fits-all AI theory.
Develop an Enterprise AI Strategy: Implement a real AI solution inside your own organization, not a simulation or case study.
Understand Modern AI Technologies: Understand how modern AI systems actually work, so you can evaluate vendors and direct implementation with confidence.
Earn a Prestigious IIM Kozhikode Credential: Earn a Certificate of Successful Completion, with a 2-day campus immersion built in.
This is fundamentally different from an IIM Kozhikode Strategic Management Course focused on classical strategy frameworks. Here, every framework is built specifically around AI-led decisions.

metadata.document_title: IIMK AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program

heading: Who Should Enroll in this AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program from IIM Kozhikode?
text:
Unlike a general Professional Certificate Program in Business Management IIM Kozhikode offers for broader strategy training, the AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program from IIM Kozhikode is built for leaders driving business outcomes with AI specifically, not for engineers learning to code.
Business Leaders, Product, Strategy & Growth Leaders: Responsible for delivering results and looking to lead AI adoption for efficiency and competitive edge.
Functional Leaders in Finance, Marketing, Operations, Sales, HR: Domain professionals who want to integrate AI directly into functional workflows and decision-making.
Business & Analytics Professionals: Involved in planning and reporting, looking to leverage AI for sharper insights and organizational impact.
Consultants & Client Professionals: Applying AI-driven solutions in client engagements and strategic advisory work.
This AI for Business Professionals Certification is not designed for those seeking deep technical or coding skills. It's built for professionals who need to lead, direct, and evaluate AI, not build it from scratch.

heading: What is Artificial Intelligence?
text:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a simulation of human intelligence by computers to perform tasks including understanding language, solving problems, recognizing patterns, and making decisions.
Artificial Intelligence learns from data and uses that learning to give results. Unlike basic programs that follow fixed rules, AI can improve over time and handle new situations.
Some of the most common Artificial Intelligence systems include GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and several others. These systems can understand, write, code, summarize, translate, and perform various functions.

Artificial Intelligence works across many industries and helps you to complete tasks faster and with better accuracy. Some key uses of AI are:
Product: It helps you build smart features, improve user experience, automate testing, and track how users interact with your product.
Banking: It helps you assess risk, detect unusual activity, automate checks, and support faster decision-making.
Retail: It helps you to understand customer behavior, recommend products, manage demand, and improve inventory planning.
Healthcare: It helps you to study patient data, assist in diagnosis, support treatment planning, and monitor patient progress.
Marketing: It helps you to understand audience needs, improve targeting, create better campaigns, and track performance.
Operations: It helps you analyze data, improve processes, reduce manual work, and support daily business decisions.

text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He has been working in the field of Computing for over 25 years in various capacities across industry and academia. His expertise lies in the fields of data science, software engineering, and large scale application development. He holds a Ph.D. degree from Mississippi State University, with his research focused on object-oriented databases. heading: Dr. C. Ramanathan
text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He has been working in the field of Computing for over 25 years in various capacities across industry and academia. He has been associated with IIITB for over 15 years where he has been teaching and carrying out research in diverse areas. His expertise lies in the fields of data science, software engineering, and large scale application development. He holds a Ph.D. degree from Mississippi State University, with his research focused on object-oriented databases. His teaching interests are in the areas of data modeling, data analytics, database design, and software architecture. His current research focus is Data Science, Model-based Software Engineering, and Technology for Education. He has authored several research papers and supervised thesis work of four PhD students, who have now graduated from IIIT-B under his guidance. He is currently heading Machine Intelligence and Robotics Center (MINRO) and Center for Technology Research and Innovation – Digital Governance (CTRI-DG), both of which are funded by Government of Karnataka. He is passionate about the use of technology for improving the quality of education. He serves on the Technical Advisory Panels of many departments of the Government of Karnataka including the Department of Education, Finance, and Center for Smart Governance. He also serves as a subject-matter expert on the Board of Studies of several HEI (Higher Educational Institutions). Dr. Chandrashekar was a Board member in the “Board for IT Education Standards (BITES)” between 2013 and 2023. He was recognized in the list of “Top 10 Data Science academicians of India” by the Analytics India magazine for the year 2018 and again in 2019.

heading: Prof. V. Sridhar
text: Dr. V. Sridhar (vsridhar@iiitb.ac.in) is a Professor at the Centre for IT and Public Policy at the International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore, India. He is the author of three books: Telecom Revolution in India: Technology, Regulation and Policy (2012), The Dynamics of Spectrum Management: Legacy, Technology, and Economics (2014), and Emerging ICT Policies and Regulations: Roadmap to Digital Economies (2019). His edited a book titled Data-Centric Living: Algorithms, Digitization and Regulation was published by Routledge (2022). Dr. Sridhar has taught at many institutions in the USA, Finland, New Zealand and India. He was a Visiting Scholar at the Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism, University of Southern California, U.S.A. during May-June, 2021; April-May, 2022, June 2024 and Mar-July, 2025. He has received funding from different sources, both national and international for his research projects, recent ones being from Facebook. He has been a member of Government of India committees on Telecom and IT and has published many peer-reviewed articles in telecom and information systems journals. He has also written more than 300 article in newspapers and magazines on telecom regulation in India. Dr. Sridhar has a Ph.D. from the University of Iowa, U.S.A. heading: Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program
text:
Technology leadership has moved past writing code and managing sprints. Boards now expect their most senior technologist to own strategy, prove ROI, and speak the language of the business. The Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program from IIIT Bangalore and IIM Udaipur was built for exactly that shift.

heading: 1 . What is a Chief Technology Officer?
text: A Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a senior executive responsible for defining an organization's technology vision, innovation strategy, and digital transformation roadmap. CTOs ensure that technology investments support business growth, improve operational efficiency, and create long-term competitive advantage.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 2 . What does a CTO do differently from a CIO?
text: While a Chief Information Officer (CIO) focuses on managing internal IT systems and operations, a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) leads technology innovation, product architecture, engineering strategy, and emerging technology adoption to drive business growth and customer value.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 3 . What makes this Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program different from others?
text: The Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program uniquely combines IIIT Bangalore's technical expertise with IIM Udaipur's leadership and business strategy curriculum. It integrates AI, MLOps, platform engineering, FinOps, executive leadership, and business strategy into one comprehensive executive program.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 4 . What is the duration of the Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program?
text: The program runs for 24 weeks (approximately six months) in a blended learning format. Participants attend live weekend sessions, complete recorded pre-work, and dedicate around 7 hours per week, making it suitable for working professionals.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

text: The Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program fee is INR 3,65,000. Applicants are required to pay a seat-blocking amount, while the remaining fee can be paid through flexible EMI options.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 6 . Do I need a technical background to apply?
text: The program is primarily designed for professionals with a technology or engineering background. However, senior business leaders and managers responsible for technology strategy, digital transformation, or innovation initiatives can also apply and benefit from the curriculum.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 7 . Can I pursue this program while working full-time?
text: Yes. The program is specifically designed for working professionals. Its flexible format combines weekend live classes with recorded learning modules, allowing participants to balance their studies with full-time professional responsibilities.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 8 . What is the Strategic CTO Dossier?
text: The Strategic CTO Dossier is a board-ready leadership portfolio developed throughout all eight modules of the program. It includes architecture blueprints, AI strategies, financial business cases, governance frameworks, and executive presentations that demonstrate your readiness for senior technology leadership roles.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 9 . What roles can I pursue after completing this program?
text: Graduates can pursue senior technology leadership roles such as Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Head of Engineering, VP of Technology, VP of Product and Technology, Chief Innovation Officer, or other executive positions leading digital transformation and AI initiatives.

text: Yes. Participants who successfully complete the program receive a joint executive certificate and gain executive alumni status from both IIIT Bangalore and IIM Udaipur, providing access to two prestigious professional networks and enhancing the program's industry recognition.

heading: The Complete Curriculum
text:
A Structured Path to AI Security Mastery
Foundations for AI and Cybersecurity
BRIDGE
2 weeks
Topics covered
Python for security automation: integrating NumPy, Pandas, and Jupyter with security data pipelines; API interactions for threat intelligence feeds
ML workflow integration: connecting model training to security evaluation; class imbalance strategies applied to phishing and malware datasets
Security tools setup: Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite basics, Kali Linux, Docker, Git workflow
Cloud integration: confirming console access across AWS/Azure/GCP; verifying IAM roles and permissions for subsequent module labs
MITRE ATT&CK introduction: SOC workflow understanding
Cybersecurity Foundations, Threat Modeling, and Threat Landscape
Module 1
3 weeks
Global and India threat landscape: APTs, ransomware, supply chain attacks, UPI fraud, digital arrest scams
MITRE ATT&CK framework deep-dive, cyber kill chain, threat intelligence fundamentals
Threat modeling (STRIDE): assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, mitigation mapping
Identity attacks and defences: OAuth/OIDC flows, JWT misuse, session fixation, refresh token theft, SSO/SAML basics
Vulnerability management, CVSS 4.0, and security operations fundamentals
Skills acquired
AI/ML for Security and Detection Engineering
Module 2
5 weeks
Security data engineering: feature extraction from logs, handling extreme class imbalance
Machine learning for threat detection: malware classification, phishing detection, fraud detection
Security-grade evaluation: calibration, thresholding, cost-of-error analysis, failure modes
MLOps starter: experiment tracking, model registry basics, reproducibility discipline
Detection-as-code fundamentals: Sigma rule syntax, detection logic patterns mapped to ATT&CK
Detection testing: unit tests for rules, coverage analysis, and false positive analysis
SIEM architecture with Elastic Stack: focused log ingestion and correlation
Incident cockpit design: severity scoring, alert correlation, response recommendations
SOAR basics: playbook design principles and human-in-the-loop workflows
Optional self-paced: UEBA behavioural baselines; IR/forensics foundations
Adversarial ML, LLM Security, Agentic AI, and Frontier Attack Surfaces
Module 3
Agentic AI pipeline foundations: LangChain and LangGraph architecture, tool-calling patterns, MCP basics, agent memory, and decision chaining
Adversarial ML fundamentals: evasion, poisoning, and extraction attacks through MITRE ATLAS
OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025): Prompt Injection, Excessive Agency, Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
LLM security and secure RAG: prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaking, data leakage, retrieval poisoning, and data exfiltration via retrieved documents
AI-specific incident response: model rollback, data poisoning forensics, and model integrity verification
LLM red teaming toolstack: PyRIT for automated red teaming, Garak for OWASP LLM Top 10 vulnerability scanning, and PromptBench for prompt robustness evaluation
Multimodal jailbreaks: Multi-Modal Linkage, perceptual transformation exploits, and Visual Scenario Hypnosis in vision-language models
Tool-calling exploitation: function call injection, tool chain exploitation, and parameter poisoning in agentic AI
MCP prompt injection: server-to-server trust override in Model Context Protocol environments
Memory poisoning: trigger-free single-shot poisoning via benign-looking content in long-context LLM agents
Model hub supply chain attacks: namespace hijacking, safetensors conversion exploitation, and detection tooling
MLSecOps, DevSecOps, and India Compliance
Module 4
4 weeks
Implement a DevSecOps + MLSecOps pipeline with policy-as-code enforcement (OPA), runtime detection (Falco), model signing (Sigstore), and AI-BOM generation (Apply)
Produce auditor-ready DPDP Rules 2025 compliance artifacts: breach notification workflow, Consent Manager integration, Data Fiduciary obligations checklist (Create)
Map an organisation's security controls to the SEBI CSCRF 2024 structured audit format, including RE classification tier assignment (Apply)
Document board-level IT risk accountability obligations under RBI Master Directions 2024 with a CERT-In notification playbook (Create)
AI Governance, Global Regulation, Risk Quantification, and Executive Communication

heading: What is the Chief Data and AI Officer Program About?
text:
The CDO/CDAIO is the executive who owns the organisation's data and AI strategy - from architecture to monetisation to governance.
Every enterprise today runs on data. But who owns it at the strategic level? Who builds the investment case for data? Who governs AI systems, evaluates vendors, and is personally accountable when they fail? Who ensures compliance across DPDP, RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI? Who turns analytics from a support function into a driver of innovation and enterprise value? And as AI products scale, who governs the data, risk, and compliance layer they depend on?
That is the CDO/CDAIO mandate.
It is one of the fastest-growing C-suite roles globally - 90% of large enterprises now have one. In India, the role is accelerating, driven by regulatory pressure, AI adoption at scale, and the growing recognition that data leadership requires its own seat at the table.
This program is built for the leader who will hold that mandate.

heading: Prof. C. Ramanathan
text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He has been working in the field of Computing for over 25 years in various capacities across industry and academia. He has been associated with IIITB for over 15 years where he has been teaching and carrying out research in diverse areas. His expertise lies in the fields of data science, software engineering, and large scale application development. He holds a Ph.D. degree from Mississippi State University, with his research focused on object-oriented databases. His teaching interests are in the areas of data modeling, data analytics, database design, and software architecture. His current research focus is Data Science, Model-based Software Engineering, and Technology for Education. He has authored several research papers and supervised thesis work of four PhD students, who have now graduated from IIIT-B under his guidance. He is currently heading Machine Intelligence and Robotics Center (MINRO) and Center for Technology Research and Innovation – Digital Governance (CTRI-DG), both of which are funded by Government of Karnataka. He is passionate about the use of technology for improving the quality of education. He serves on the Technical Advisory Panels of many departments of the Government of Karnataka including the Department of Education, Finance, and Center for Smart Governance. He also serves as a subject-matter expert on the Board of Studies of several HEI (Higher Educational Institutions). Dr. Chandrashekar was a Board member in the “Board for IT Education Standards (BITES)” between 2013 and 2023. heading: Why a Chief Data and AI Officer Program Matters in 2026?
text:
As enterprises scale their data estates and AI adoption accelerates, the Chief Data and AI Officer role has moved from emerging to essential. 90% of large enterprises globally now have a CDO. In India, the role is gaining momentum - driven by DPDP compliance deadlines, AI governance requirements, and the growing need to treat data as a strategic asset rather than a technology input.
Today's CDOs are not just analytics leaders - they own the enterprise data strategy, govern AI systems, build the investment case for data, and are personally accountable for regulatory compliance across DPDP, RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI. The role demands a combination of technical authority over data architecture and AI, and business authority over data economics, monetisation, and C-suite leadership.
Whether you are a Director of Data looking to step into the CDO role, a Head of AI/ML looking to broaden your mandate, or a Senior Manager in analytics preparing for the next level - this program gives you the frameworks, credentials, and peer network to get there.

metadata.document_title: IIIT-B & IIMU Chief Data and AI Officer Programme Online

heading: Who Can Pursue This Chief Data and AI Officer Program?
text:

Prototype-to-production gap analysis and stakeholder presentation

Agentic workflows - tool use, planning, multi-agent orchestration
MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard
HITL / HOTL / HOOTL autonomy taxonomy - designing agent boundaries
India Stack as agent infrastructure - UPI, Aadhaar, Account Aggregator
Data flywheel design and infrastructure literacy for PMs
AI Evaluation & Red Teaming

RAGAS metrics and LLM-as-judge methodology
Quality gates - launch, target, and aspirational thresholds
Adversarial red teaming - prompt injection, jailbreaks, Hinglish adversarial inputs

Ship / No-Ship decision protocol based on evaluation evidence
AI Analytics & Experimentation
Module 7
4-Tier AI Metrics Model - model, system, product, and business metrics
AI-native metrics - acceptance rate, override rate, cost-per-correct-output
A/B testing for non-deterministic outputs - shadow deployment, interleaving
Model drift detection - performance monitoring and retraining triggers
Feedback loop design as product operations
Instrumentation spec and experiment design for AI products
AI Product Economics & Go-to-Market
Module 8
LLM unit economics - token + infrastructure + orchestration costs in INR
The whale user problem and cost governance strategy
AI pricing playbook - consumption-based, outcome-based, seat-based models
GTM for AI trust challenges - trust-first positioning and enterprise AI sales
India market channels - WhatsApp, ONDC, GeM, IndiaAI Mission
Change management and stakeholder alignment for AI products
AI Operations, Safety & Compliance
Module 9
DPDP Act 2023 - consent architecture, data minimisation, purpose limitation
NIST AI RMF - risk tiering, documentation, governance framework
EU AI Act risk tiers and prohibited use cases
RBI FREE-AI framework for financial AI products
Production monitoring, model drift response, go/no-go escalation
AI incident response protocol and regulatory notification
Capstone - IIT Faculty Defence

Working AI Prototype + Production Handoff Specification

The Executive Post Graduate Certificate in AI-Native Software Engineering from IIT Kharagpur is an 8-month, live online program for working software engineers who need to build AI into the core of their systems, not as a bolted-on feature.
The rush to integrate Generative AI has exposed a critical skills gap in the tech industry. According to Gartner, at least 30% of GenAI projects were abandoned after the proof-of-concept phase by 2025 due to escalating costs, poor risk controls, and a lack of clear business value. While many developers can build a basic RAG demo or call an LLM API, the industry is actively seeking engineers who can deploy scalable, secure, and cost-effective AI systems in live production environments.

heading: 1 . What is Tableau, and how is it useful for beginners in data visualization?
text: Tableau is a powerful yet user-friendly data visualization tool designed to help users especially beginners, turn raw data into clear, interactive dashboards and visual reports. With Tableau Public (free) or Tableau Desktop (paid), you can connect to spreadsheets, cloud databases, or even web data, and build meaningful visuals without writing a single line of code.

metadata.document_title: Tableau Courses Online

heading: 2 . How do I start using Tableau Desktop for data analysis?
text: If you are new to Tableau, we recommend starting with the free Tableau Desktop Personal Edition. It will allow you to connect to your data, create visualizations, and share them with others. Once you have mastered the basics of Tableau, you can upgrade to the Professional Edition or purchase Tableau Server licenses.

metadata.document_title: Tableau Courses Online

heading: 3 . What is the architecture of Tableau Desktop, and why does it matter?
text: The Tableau Desktop architecture is built around three core layers: Data Layer, Data Engine, and Visualization Layer. This means you can connect to almost any data source, process it quickly using Tableau’s in-memory engine, and then visualize it using a dynamic front-end interface. This architecture allows real-time interaction with large datasets making Tableau software ideal for analysts, marketers, and business teams.

metadata.document_title: Tableau Courses Online

heading: 4 . How is Tableau different from other BI tools?
text: Other BI tools require users to write SQL queries or learn a proprietary scripting language to extract data for analysis. Tableau requires no such queries or scripts - users can simply point and click to analyze data stored in almost any format. In addition, Tableau’s visualizations are highly interactive and allow users to drill down into the data to uncover trends and patterns that would be difficult to spot in raw data.

heading: 1 . What is the history of Natural Language Processing?
text: NLP has a long and rich history, dating back to the early days of computing. In 1950, Alan Turing published his famous paper "Computing Machinery and Intelligence", in which he proposed the now-famous Turing test as a way to determine whether a machine could be said to be truly intelligent. This paper is often cited as the beginning of artificial intelligence and NLP research.

upGrad's deep learning courses offer a comprehensive and practical roadmap. The curriculum aligns with the latest industry demands, covering everything from neural networks to deployment strategies.
For example , programs like the Executive Diploma in Machine Learning & AI from IIIT Bangalore provide an in-depth understanding of machine learning and deep learning syllabus topics, while the Generative AI Foundations Certificate in Data Analysis helps you explore practical applications of deep learning in data analysis both designed for learners who want flexible, outcome-oriented education.
Here’s what you’ll typically learn:
Foundational concepts : Understand neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, and deep neural architectures, core topics in any deep learning course syllabus.
Industry-standard tools : Gain hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras, part of most advanced deep learning classes.
Real-world projects : Apply your knowledge through case studies in computer vision, NLP, and anomaly detection, common applications of deep learning in today’s tech world.
End-to-end model training : Learn how to preprocess data, build models, evaluate performance, and deploy systems, skills taught in both machine learning and deep learning course outlines.
Integration with ML concepts : The curriculum blends well with broader machine learning subjects, ensuring you're not just learning in isolation but gaining a holistic AI skillset.

heading: DBUS 933
text:
BUS 901 - Academic Scholarship and Doctoral Studies
Use critical thinking models and practices, including the role of assumptions, to identify business problems
Topics :
Introduction to Business Research
Identification of the Research Problem
Determination of the Research Design
Identification of the Sampling and Data Collection Strategy
Determination of the Data Analysis Strategy
Presenting Results
BUS 903 - Analyzing Behavior in Organizations
Understand the processes used to analyze organizational behavior, development and leadership
Topics:
Making Sense of Organizations
The Structural Frame
The Human Resource Frame
The Political Frame
The Symbolic Frame
Leadership Practice
BUS 920 - Quantitative Analysis I: Quantitative Research and Analysis
Understand the application of quantitative analytical techniques to problems in business enterprises
Working with Data
Linear Regression
Multiple Regression
Regression Interpretation
Linear Regression Assumptions
BUS 921 - Qualitative Research
Formulate appropriate qualitative research plans, questions, conduct a planned analysis, and communicate their findings
Narrative Methodology
Phenomenological Methodology
Grounded Theory Methodology
Ethnographic Methodology
Case Study Methodology
Qualitative Data Collection and Analysis
BUS 922 - Quantitative Analysis II: Applied Regression Analysis
Execute a quantitative estimation plan that is coherent to both the posed research question(s) and the nature of the necessary/relevant data
Review and Adjustments to OLS
Non-OLS Estimation
Limited Dependent Variable Models
Panel Data
Time Series Data
Event Studies
BUS 902 - Business Ethics & Sustainability
Explore new and emerging sustainable business strategies that create a competitive advantage to support organizations.
Introduction to Ethics, Dominican Values, and Four Theories
Consequentialism and Partnership
Deontology
Virtue Ethics
Social Contract Theory
Sustainability Strategies and Ethics
BUS 910 - Financial Decision-Making and Value Creation
Understand the genesis of the major finance sub-fields and how they have evolved through the fields’ ongoing knowledge creation.
Asset Pricing
Market Efficiency
Frictions and Incentives
Corporate Finance
Derivative Securities
Behavioral Finance
Market Microstructure
BUS 904 - Executive supply chain strategy and negotiations
Identify, dissect, and answer strategic management problems
Inventory, Cost, and Forecasting
Demand Forecasting
Probability-Based Control and Multiechelon Systems
Supply Chain: Finance, Market, and Winning Orders
Supply Chain: The Supply Side Perspective
Negotiations: Culture and Engagement
Negotiations: Perspective and Agreement
DBUS 930 | Applied Doctoral Research Proposal - I
8 Weeks
Students apply the fundamentals of research writing, and how the principles of business research writing will be followed in the applied doctoral research deliverable.
DBUS 931 | Applied Doctoral Research Proposal - I
This part of the proposal contains a synthesis of sufficient academic and business literature to support the need to address the proposed business problem/question.
DBUS 932 | Applied Doctoral Research: Findings and Conclusions
In this deliverable, the students will need to report the findings based on the analysis of collected data.
DBUS 933 | Applied Doctoral Research Defense and Completion
Based on the conclusions about the findings of the study, the students will be expected to recommend the solutions that can be used to address the problem/question. The student will also be expected to prepare an execution plan.

text: While both are doctoral-level qualifications, a DBA is practice-oriented, focusing on applying research to business contexts, whereas a PhD is theory-driven, emphasizing original academic contributions. heading: Agentic AI and Generative AI Course Overview
text:
Work practices are changing at a fast pace across engineering, product, and business teams across the globe. AI systems have advanced beyond just answering queries; they are now able to plan work, coordinate workflows, interact with tools and produce tangible results with little human intervention. This emerging field is called Agentic AI.
upGrad offers online courses on Agentic AI and Generative AI for those who want to be prepared for this revolution. Be it a software engineer who wants to create AI native products, a data professional trying to specialize in Large Language Model (LLM), or a business leader who wants to understand and implement intelligent automation, such programs provide skills relevant to the actual professional world.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: What Is Generative AI?
text: Generative AI is the type of Artificial Intelligence that has the capability to generate new content based on the information it was trained on. It can comprehend the user query and produce output accordingly and hence is used for performing work related to content creation, coding, research, design, and similar areas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are often used in Generative AI systems.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: How Does Generative AI Work?
text:
The generative AI uses trained models for identifying patterns within existing data and generating new data based on user instructions or inputs. The process of working with a generative AI typically involves:
Data: Models learn patterns from large amounts of training data.
Training: AI models are trained to understand language, images, code, audio, or other types of data.
Prompt: You provide an instruction or input to the model.
Processing: The model understands the input and identifies relevant patterns.
Generation: The model creates new content based on the given prompt.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: What Is Agentic AI?
text: Agentic AI means AI systems capable of achieving the goal using task planning, reasoning, tool use, API calls, context, and action. Unlike the system that can only provide output for the user's input, an AI agent breaks down the task into smaller pieces and works in a particular workflow with minimum human intervention.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: How Do AI Agents Work?
text:
An AI agent combines an AI model with instructions, tools, memory, data, and actions to complete a task. A typical AI agent workflow includes:
Goal: Understand what needs to be completed.
Planning: Break the goal into smaller tasks.
Reasoning: Decide what steps are required.
Tool Use: Access APIs, databases, search systems, or other tools.
Memory: Maintain relevant information and context.
Action: Execute the required tasks.
Evaluation: Check the result and take further action when needed.

metadata.document_title: Agentic AI Courses Online, Training & Certification

heading: What Is the Difference Between Generative AI and Agentic AI?
text:
Generative AI and Agentic AI are related but focus on different capabilities. The key difference between both technologies are:
Technology
What It Does
Examples of Use
Generative AI
Creates new content based on user inputs and available information
Text generation, code generation, images, reports, marketing content
Agentic AI
Plans and performs multi-step tasks using models, tools, APIs, and workflows
AI assistants, workflow automation, multi-agent systems, tool-based tasks

heading: What is the Executive Post Graduate Programme in Applied AI and Agentic AI?
text:
The Executive Post Graduate Programme in Applied AI and Agentic AI by upGrad and IIIT Bangalore is a 7-month advanced certification designed for professionals who want to go beyond traditional AI.
This program helps you master both Applied AI and Agentic AI, enabling you to design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents that can plan, act, and make autonomous decisions in real-world settings.
Through 240+ hours of learning, 8+ projects, and 2 industry-grade capstones, you'll learn how to apply Agentic AI concepts to design and build real-world solutions across 12+ industry domains, including Healthcare, BFSI, Retail, Manufacturing, Media, Education, LegalTech, and more.
Program Highlights:
Duration : 7 Months (Online Learning)
Executive Alumni Status: IIIT Bangalore
Projects & Capstones: 30+ Hands-on Projects and 2 Industry Capstones
Tools Covered: 32+ AI and Agentic Tools, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AWS
AI Deployment Focus: Build and deploy enterprise-ready AI agents

heading: Dr. V. Sridhar
text: Dr. V. Sridhar (vsridhar@iiitb.ac.in) is a Professor at the Centre for IT and Public Policy at the International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore, India. He is the author of three books: Telecom Revolution in India: Technology, Regulation and Policy (2012), The Dynamics of Spectrum Management: Legacy, Technology, and Economics (2014), and Emerging ICT Policies and Regulations: Roadmap to Digital Economies (2019). His edited a book titled Data-Centric Living: Algorithms, Digitization and Regulation was published by Routledge (2022). His co-authored new book titled "5G and Beyond: Rewiring Telecom Regulation", has just been published by the Oxford University Press. Dr. Sridhar has taught at many institutions in the USA, Finland, New Zealand and India. He was a Visiting Scholar at the Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism, University of Southern California, U.S.A. during May-June, 2021; April-May, 2022, June 2024 and Mar-July, 2025. He has received funding from different sources, both national and international for his research projects, recent ones being from Facebook. He has been a member of Government of India committees on Telecom and IT and has published many peer-reviewed articles in telecom and information systems journals. He has also written more than 300 article in newspapers and magazines on telecom regulation in India. Dr. Sridhar has a Ph.D. from the University of Iowa, U.S.A. heading: Dr. C. Ramanathan
text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He has been working in the field of Computing for over 25 years in various capacities across industry and academia. He has been associated with IIITB for over 15 years where he has been teaching and carrying out research in diverse areas. His expertise lies in the fields of data science, software engineering, and large scale application development. He is passionate about the use of technology for improving the quality of education. He serves on the Technical Advisory Panels of many departments of the Government of Karnataka including the Department of Education, Finance, and Center for Smart Governance. He also serves as a subject-matter expert on the Board of Studies of several HEI (Higher Educational Institutions). Dr. Chandrashekar was a Board member in the “Board for IT Education Standards (BITES)” between 2013 and 2023. The Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering from IIIT Bangalore is built for engineers who want to own AI results end-to-end, not just build models in isolation.

heading: What is the Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering?
text:
This is a 120+ hour, 6-month executive programme designed to train engineers for the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) role: the person who sits at the intersection of client discovery, AI architecture, and production deployment.
Rather than treating GenAI as a standalone skill, the Executive Post Graduate Programme in Forward Deployed AI Engineering teaches learners to scope a client's real problem, build the AI solution, deploy it into the industry environments, and defend the outcome to business stakeholders.
The program includes:
5 hands-on projects across the curriculum
1 live client capstone on Demo Day
A 1-day campus immersion at IIIT Bangalore
Sessions delivered by practicing Forward Deployed Engineers and AI experts, not only academic faculty
IIIT Bangalore alumni status on completion
Anyone searching for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer Course Online will notice most options are either pure GenAI courses or pure cloud-deployment courses. This program combines both GenAI and cloud deployment, making it ideal for professionals who need an Forward Deployed Engineer course online option rather than a full-time, on-campus course.

heading: Who is a Forward Deployed Engineer?
text:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is an engineer who works closely with clients to understand their problems and build solutions that can be used in real-world settings. Instead of stopping after creating a demo, an FDE takes the project from problem identification and solution planning to development and production.
The curriculum of this program reflects this directly, teaching learners to "think like an FDE": client discovery, architecture and solution scoping, not just model training.

heading: IIM Kozhikode Strategic AI for Business Professionals Program
text:
IIM Kozhikode Strategic AI for Business Professionals is a 6-month, blended Professional Certificate Program in AI for Business Professionals, built for leaders who need to make AI decisions, not just understand AI concepts.
88% of companies now use AI in at least one business function, yet most non-technical professionals are stuck choosing between courses that are too technical to follow or too theoretical to apply. This AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program from IIM Kozhikode is designed to eliminate that choice entirely; no coding required.
It includes:
90+ hours of self-paced content, live workshops, and applied projects
6 modules plus a Leadership Capstone, built around your own organization's AI opportunity
A 2-day campus immersion at IIM Kozhikode, with a case competition and capstone presentation
A Certificate of Successful Completion from IIM Kozhikode
This program is also referred to informally as the AI for Business Professionals Course or the IIM Kozhikode AI Course, though the official name on your credential is the Professional Certificate Program in AI for Business Professionals.

metadata.document_title: IIMK AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program

heading: Why Choose this Professional Certificate Program in AI for Business Professionals?
text:
The IIMK AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program teaches how to apply AI in your domain and your organization, not just understand it in the abstract.
Learn AI Without Coding: Learn AI without a technical background, anchored to a real business deliverable in every module.
Apply AI Across Business Functions: AI playbooks across Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, and Sales, not one-size-fits-all AI theory.
Develop an Enterprise AI Strategy: Implement a real AI solution inside your own organization, not a simulation or case study.
Understand Modern AI Technologies: Understand how modern AI systems actually work, so you can evaluate vendors and direct implementation with confidence.
Earn a Prestigious IIM Kozhikode Credential: Earn a Certificate of Successful Completion, with a 2-day campus immersion built in.
This is fundamentally different from an IIM Kozhikode Strategic Management Course focused on classical strategy frameworks. Here, every framework is built specifically around AI-led decisions.

metadata.document_title: IIMK AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program

heading: Who Should Enroll in this AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program from IIM Kozhikode?
text:
Unlike a general Professional Certificate Program in Business Management IIM Kozhikode offers for broader strategy training, the AI for Business Professionals Certificate Program from IIM Kozhikode is built for leaders driving business outcomes with AI specifically, not for engineers learning to code.
Business Leaders, Product, Strategy & Growth Leaders: Responsible for delivering results and looking to lead AI adoption for efficiency and competitive edge.
Functional Leaders in Finance, Marketing, Operations, Sales, HR: Domain professionals who want to integrate AI directly into functional workflows and decision-making.
Business & Analytics Professionals: Involved in planning and reporting, looking to leverage AI for sharper insights and organizational impact.
Consultants & Client Professionals: Applying AI-driven solutions in client engagements and strategic advisory work.
This AI for Business Professionals Certification is not designed for those seeking deep technical or coding skills. It's built for professionals who need to lead, direct, and evaluate AI, not build it from scratch.

heading: Curriculum
text:
The Path from Data Foundations to Agentic AI
Python & AI-Powered Programming
Module 1
4 Weeks
Topics covered
Python Programming - variables, data types, functions, file I/O, AI-assisted debugging
Prompt Engineering for Coding - zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output
Data Manipulation - NumPy, Pandas, filtering, merging, GroupBy, pivot tables
Developer Foundations - Git, API key management, integration capstone, portfolio setup
Learning Outcome:
Write, debug and structure Python programs with Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistance, and use prompt engineering as a working tool.
SQL, Data Engineering & Cloud Platforms
Module 2
SQL - SELECT, JOINs, window functions, CTEs, query optimisation, SQL with Python
Pipeline Architecture - ETL/ELT, batch vs streaming, data modelling, data quality, Docker
dbt Essentials - models, sources, schema tests, incremental models, Jinja
Orchestration & Cloud - Airflow, BigQuery, cloud storage, MLflow, data engineering project
Platform Awareness - Dagster, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, Lakehouse, DVC
Model and query data using SQL, and build and orchestrate reliable data pipelines on the cloud.
BI, Visual Analytics & Business Metrics
Module 3
Business Intelligence - Power BI, data modelling, DAX, time intelligence, dashboard publishing
Visualisation & Tools - Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau overview
Data Storytelling - chart selection, design principles, accessibility, narrative frameworks
Metrics & Frameworks - KPI trees, North Star metrics, LTV, CAC, churn, funnel analysis, RFM
Build Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards in Power BI and communicate insight through evidence-based data storytelling.
Statistics, Experimentation & Forecasting
Module 4
Exploratory Data Analysis - univariate, bivariate, multivariate analysis, feature creation, outlier detection
Statistical Foundations - normal distribution, CLT, sampling, confidence intervals
Hypothesis Testing & A/B - z-test, t-test, A/B testing, sample size, significance
Time Series Forecasting - stationarity, ARIMA, Prophet, validation, forecasting metrics
Apply statistics, experimentation, and time series forecasting to real business decisions.
Machine Learning, Explainability & Model Deployment
Module 5
Machine Learning Foundations - ML lifecycle, feature engineering, evaluation metrics, bias-variance, governance
Supervised Learning - linear & logistic regression, decision trees, imbalanced data
Ensembles, Clustering & AutoML - Random Forest, XGBoost, K-Means, PCA, AutoML
Explainability & Responsible AI - SHAP, LIME, bias auditing, responsible AI
Deployment & Integration - MLflow, model serving, FastAPI, A/B testing, integrative project
Build, evaluate, explain and deploy Machine Learning (ML) models following responsible AI practice.
Agentic AI, RAG & AI Engineering
Module 6
LLM & NLP Foundations - transformers, attention, embeddings, tokenisation, prompting
RAG & Vector Search - embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, RAG, retrieval evaluation
Agentic AI - AI agents, function calling, tool use, memory, guardrails
Multi-Agent Orchestration - LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP, human-in-the-loop
MLOps & Data Governance - model monitoring, CI/CD, LangSmith, governance, GenAI ethics
Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic AI systems, and reason about their governance and cost.
Capstone: End-to-End AI-Powered Business Solution
Module 7
2 Weeks
Start - problem selection, data sourcing, project planning, success criteria
Build - pipeline design, EDA, ML model, AI integration, explainability
Deliver - dashboard, automated reporting, executive pitch, case study
Deliverable:
Deliver an end-to-end, AI-powered business solution and present it to an executive panel.

heading: What Is Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
text:
AI (Artificial Intelligence) is a technology for simulating human intelligence with computing machines for carrying out activities like language comprehension, problem solving, pattern recognition, and decision making.
AI makes sense out of the data and creates outcomes based on the information gained. Unlike traditional systems that function within pre-set parameters, AI systems have the capability of improving with learning and dealing with new situations.
Some of the widely used AI models include GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and many more. The common ability of these AI models includes language comprehension, creating text, programming, summarizing, translation, and much more.

metadata.document_title: Artificial Intelligence Course Online | Best AI Courses [2026]

heading: How Does Artificial Intelligence Work?
text:
In order to find patterns and produce results, artificial intelligence uses data, algorithms and machine learning models. Depending on the task, an AI system may process data, text, images, video or other information.
In an AI workflow, the following steps are performed:
Data collection: Gather the information needed for the task.
Data preprocessing: Clean and prepare the data for analysis or model training.
Model building: Using machine learning or deep learning methods to create a model.
Training: Train the model with the data to discover patterns.
Evaluation: Test the model to see how it performs.
Application: Use the trained model for prediction, classification, recommendation, automation or other AI tasks.

heading: 12 . What is the difference between AI, ML and Deep Learning?
text:
AI is the wider term for the creation of machines which can do things that normally require intelligence. Machine learning (ML) is a part of AI which allows systems to learn from data and make predictions or decisions.
Deep learning (DL) is a part of ML which involves using multi-layered neural networks for recognizing complex patterns in big amounts of data. To sum up, AI is the more general term, ML is the methodology, while DL is a particular method of ML.

heading: Dr. C. Ramanathan
text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He has been working in the field of Computing for over 25 years in various capacities across industry and academia. He has been associated with IIITB for over 15 years where he has been teaching and carrying out research in diverse areas. His expertise lies in the fields of data science, software engineering, and large scale application development. He holds a Ph.D. degree from Mississippi State University, with his research focused on object-oriented databases. His teaching interests are in the areas of data modeling, data analytics, database design, and software architecture. His current research focus is Data Science, Model-based Software Engineering, and Technology for Education. He has authored several research papers and supervised thesis work of four PhD students, who have now graduated from IIIT-B under his guidance. He is currently heading Machine Intelligence and Robotics Center (MINRO) and Center for Technology Research and Innovation – Digital Governance (CTRI-DG), both of which are funded by Government of Karnataka. He is passionate about the use of technology for improving the quality of education. He serves on the Technical Advisory Panels of many departments of the Government of Karnataka including the Department of Education, Finance, and Center for Smart Governance. He also serves as a subject-matter expert on the Board of Studies of several HEI (Higher Educational Institutions). Dr. Chandrashekar was a Board member in the “Board for IT Education Standards (BITES)” between 2013 and 2023. He was recognized in the list of “Top 10 Data Science academicians of India” by the Analytics India magazine for the year 2018 and again in 2019.

text: Professor Chandrashekar Ramanathan is a faculty member at IIIT-B (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore) since 2007 serving as professor, researcher and administrator. He also serves as a subject-matter expert on the Board of Studies of several HEI (Higher Educational Institutions). heading: Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program
text:
Technology leadership has moved past writing code and managing sprints. Boards now expect their most senior technologist to own strategy, prove ROI, and speak the language of the business. The Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program from IIIT Bangalore and IIM Udaipur was built for exactly that shift.
This CTO & AI Leadership Program brings together two institutions that rarely work under one certificate. IIIT Bangalore covers the deep technical ground: cloud architecture, MLOps, cyber governance. IIM Udaipur covers the business ground: P&L ownership, boardroom communication, organization design. Together they form a six-month path from senior engineering leader to board ready CTO.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: What is Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program?
text:
The CTO & AI Leadership Program is positioned as India's only dual school program of its kind, pairing a top ranked technology institute with a globally accredited business school under a single certification.
Dual Executive Certification: Earn a 24-week executive certification jointly awarded by IIIT Bangalore and IIM Udaipur.
Built for Future CTOs: Transition from technology director, engineering manager, or founder to strategic Chief Technology Officer.
Technology and Business Leadership: Develop expertise in AI, MLOps, platform engineering, business strategy, P&L management, and executive leadership.
Strategic CTO Dossier: Build a board-ready leadership portfolio module by module, showcasing your technical and strategic capabilities.
Campus Learning Experience: Participate in a 2-day AI Success Planning Workshop at IIIT Bangalore.
Dual Executive Alumni Status : Join the executive alumni networks of both IIIT Bangalore and IIM Udaipur after successful program completion.

heading: Why Choose This Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program?
text:
This CTO & AI Leadership Program stands apart from single track courses because it does not force a choice between technical depth and business fluency.
CTO-Focused Curriculum: One of the few CTO Program India options that combines production AI training with P&L and FinOps mastery
Learn from Industry Experts: Faculty includes a former CTO of Aztecsoft (now Mindtree), giving practitioner depth alongside academic rigor
Flexible Learning Format: Live weekend sessions plus recorded pre-work fit around a full-time senior role
Strengthen Product and Technology Leadership: CTO-CPO product-tech partnership training, rarely covered in comparable programs
Industry-Based Case Studies: Real enterprise case studies from Maersk, Unilever, Walmart, Nike, American Express, and JPMorgan Chase anchor the concepts in practice
Network with Senior Technology Leaders: Peer cohort drawn largely from professionals with 15 plus years of experience across IT services, BFSI, telecom, and SaaS
CXO-Led Mentorship: CXO led mentorship throughout the 24 weeks, not just in the capstone phase

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: Who Should Enroll in Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program?
text:
The CTO & AI Leadership Program is designed for experienced technology professionals who want to move into strategic leadership roles.
Technology Directors and VPs of Engineering who want to shape strategy, not just execute it
Principal or Senior Engineering Managers on the path to a VP or CTO title
Early stage or first time CTOs who hold the title but need frameworks for the board and the org
Tech entrepreneurs and founders building AI first products who need to professionalize their technology strategy
Prior AI or ML experience is not required. This CTO & AI Leadership Program builds that expertise from the ground up through the IIIT Bangalore modules before moving into the IIM Udaipur strategy phase.

heading: Eligibility for CTO & AI Leadership Program
text:
Eligibility for CTO & AI Leadership Program is intentionally kept broad on academic background but firm on experience.
Bachelor's degree in any discipline
Minimum 8 years of professional experience
A technical or engineering background is preferred, though senior business leaders managing tech functions can also apply
Prior AI or machine learning experience is not required
Most enrolled professionals bring considerably more than the minimum. Program data shows close to 40 percent of the cohort has 20 plus years of experience, with common titles including Director of Technology, VP Engineering, and Senior Architect.

heading: How to Apply for Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program
text:
Applying for Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program follows a simple four step process.
Submit your application on the upGrad website. The admissions committee reviews your profile and experience.
Get shortlisted based on your professional background and stated goals.
Receive your offer letter once the committee confirms your fit for the cohort.
Block your seat by paying the seat block amount to confirm your place in the program.
Applicants are encouraged to apply early, since cohort sizes are limited to preserve the peer quality and CXO mentorship experience central to this Chief Technology Officer Program.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 1 . What is a Chief Technology Officer?
text: A Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a senior executive responsible for defining an organization's technology vision, innovation strategy, and digital transformation roadmap. CTOs ensure that technology investments support business growth, improve operational efficiency, and create long-term competitive advantage.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 2 . What does a CTO do differently from a CIO?
text: While a Chief Information Officer (CIO) focuses on managing internal IT systems and operations, a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) leads technology innovation, product architecture, engineering strategy, and emerging technology adoption to drive business growth and customer value.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 3 . What makes this Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program different from others?
text: The Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program uniquely combines IIIT Bangalore's technical expertise with IIM Udaipur's leadership and business strategy curriculum. It integrates AI, MLOps, platform engineering, FinOps, executive leadership, and business strategy into one comprehensive executive program.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 4 . What is the duration of the Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program?
text: The program runs for 24 weeks (approximately six months) in a blended learning format. Participants attend live weekend sessions, complete recorded pre-work, and dedicate around 7 hours per week, making it suitable for working professionals.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 5 . What is the Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program fee structure?
text: The Chief Technology Officer & AI Leadership Program fee is INR 3,65,000. Applicants are required to pay a seat-blocking amount, while the remaining fee can be paid through flexible EMI options.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 6 . Do I need a technical background to apply?
text: The program is primarily designed for professionals with a technology or engineering background. However, senior business leaders and managers responsible for technology strategy, digital transformation, or innovation initiatives can also apply and benefit from the curriculum.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 7 . Can I pursue this program while working full-time?
text: Yes. The program is specifically designed for working professionals. Its flexible format combines weekend live classes with recorded learning modules, allowing participants to balance their studies with full-time professional responsibilities.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 8 . What is the Strategic CTO Dossier?
text: The Strategic CTO Dossier is a board-ready leadership portfolio developed throughout all eight modules of the program. It includes architecture blueprints, AI strategies, financial business cases, governance frameworks, and executive presentations that demonstrate your readiness for senior technology leadership roles.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 9 . What roles can I pursue after completing this program?
text: Graduates can pursue senior technology leadership roles such as Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Head of Engineering, VP of Technology, VP of Product and Technology, Chief Innovation Officer, or other executive positions leading digital transformation and AI initiatives.

metadata.document_title: Chief Technology Officer Program - ​CTO & AI Course & Certification

heading: 10 . Does the certification carry recognition from both institutes?
text: Yes. Participants who successfully complete the program receive a joint executive certificate and gain executive alumni status from both IIIT Bangalore and IIM Udaipur, providing access to two prestigious professional networks and enhancing the program's industry recognition.
